liveness_observation.limit: Snapshot of later inspection, not proof of historical process absence at dispatch. notLoaded alone is not a terminal-liveness test.

ownership.bridge: Verify current exact receiver runtime binding before new live dispatch and expose unverified/unavailable receiver as an actionable blocker. A reachable socket, matching registry and thread metadata do not prove an attended executor.
ownership.coordinator: Treat missing receiver liveness as failed acceptance, never routine waiting or successful live communication.
ownership.receiving_harness: Retains permission checks and execution; a saved thread record does not execute the queued request.

required_repair: Prepare a bounded liveness-check candidate using an exact thread-to-runtime binding or supported receiving-harness witness; when proof is unavailable, reject new live dispatch before queue addition. Independently review and qualify it without treating idle or notLoaded alone as proof.

existing_queue_custody.action: Preserve the original queued message and receipt; no resend, silent deletion, replacement, launch/resume or false verification/closure. Reconcile this exact attempt before another live test.

acceptance: FAILED. Queue delivery and disk recovery remain observed component behavior; a working live communication round trip is unqualified.
